data.name: Stoneblood
data.description: A stonelord's vitals begin to calcify and her blood transforms into liquid stone. She adds her paladin level on checks to stabilize at negative hit points and gains a 50%% chance to ignore a critical hit or precision damage and she becomes immune to petrification. This does not stack with fortification armor or similar effects.
